mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, work_date, check_in_time, check_out_time FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY work_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_record (employee_id, work_date, check_in_time) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{workDate}, #{checkInTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_record SET check_out_time = #{checkOutTime} WHERE id = #{id}
